title: Desk Guidance on Open Loans, Sponsoring Employers and Reapplication for the Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan
content:
**Rule.** A worker holds at most 1 open Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan; paid-off, charged-off, declined and withdrawn loans do not count. A worker may not hold a second loan in status applied, approved or repaying. An application is taken only through an employer whose Earned Wage Access program has been live at least the product's required number of months and that opted in to the loan benefit where the product requires the employer to have opted in; a worker declined within the product's reapply-after-decline period, counted in calendar days, cannot reapply.

### What counts as an open loan

The test is read from the company's loan records for the worker, not from the worker's own account of their loans. The worker's existing Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loans are matched to the worker, and each is placed by its status at the moment a new application is taken:

| Status of an existing loan of the same worker | Counts toward the limit of 1 |
|---|---|
| applied | Yes |
| approved | Yes |
| repaying | Yes |
| paid off | No |
| charged off | No |
| declined | No |
| withdrawn | No |

A new application is a separate loan record. Where the records already show a loan of that worker in status applied, approved or repaying, a second loan may not be held.

### The sponsoring employer

An application comes through the worker's employer. It is taken only where that employer's Earned Wage Access program has been live for at least the required number of months, and, where the product requires the employer to have opted in to the loan benefit, only where the employer has opted in.

### Reapplying after a decline

The reapply-after-decline period runs from the decline and is counted in calendar days. A worker declined within that period cannot reapply.

### Hypothetical cases

| Worker's existing loans (hypothetical) | Second loan may be held |
|---|---|
| one loan, repaying | No |
| one loan, approved and not yet accepted | No |
| one loan, applied and not yet decided | No |
| one loan, paid off | Not barred by the open-loan limit |
| one loan charged off and one withdrawn | Not barred by the open-loan limit |
